first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The soldier near the camera with their back to the camera, wearing a gray broad-brimmed steel helmet, with an orange-brown shoulder cape and a wide strap across the back, and carrying a long gun on the back.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The soldier in front of and to the right of Person A, wearing a gray steel helmet, with a raised brown collar, and carrying a square canvas pack and a long gun on the back.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: The brown earthen walls, horizontal wooden planks, and thick wooden posts on both sides of the passageway, excluding the sandbags atop the wall, mound of earth, sky, and ground.

entities.name: group of other soldiers in the trench
entities.identification: The soldiers in the trench other than Person A and Person B, excluding the soldier wearing a cape and walking toward the camera; identify them by their visible positions in each frame, without tracking the cross-segment identities of individuals within the group.

entities.name: brown sandbags atop the wall
entities.identification: The brown sandbags stacked horizontally in layers atop the wall, with bulging bag bodies and compressed edges.

entities.name: exposed mound of earth atop the wall
entities.identification: The brown exposed earth behind the sandbags, rising above the top of the wall, with a rough and uneven surface.

entities.name: grayish-white sky
entities.identification: The low-saturation grayish-white sky area above the contour of the wall top, with gradual variations in brightness.

entities.name: trench cable
entities.identification: Multiple slender dark lines extending between utility poles against the sky, locally sagging or overlapping.

entities.name: utility pole
entities.identification: The vertical pole-like structures extending into the sky area from behind the top of the wall and connected to the overhead cables.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: The two long guns extending upward behind Person A and Person B respectively, with brown wooden sections and dark metal ends.

entities.name: wooden sign
entities.identification: The yellowish-brown rectangular wooden board placed diagonally near a post of the wall on the left, with blurry light-colored strokes on its surface.
